title: Mr W Griffiths v Glasgow City Council: 4102463/2016
text:
JUDGMENT OF THE EMPLOYMENT TRIBUNAL

The Judgment of the Tribunal is that the Tribunal does not have jurisdiction to hear the claim as it was submitted out of time. The claim is dismissed.

REASONS

Oral reasons were given at the hearing.
description: Employment Tribunal decision of Judge McFatridge on 5 August 2016.
